标题: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
中文简介: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees ：在软件组织内工作的编码代理必须确定要构建的内容、与同事协作并验证其交付的内容。我们推出了 SWE-CoWork，这是一个基准测试，包含 101 个真实存储库、11 种编程语言和 12 个应用程序领域的 101 项开发任务。
具体内容摘要: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains.
